Q0162

Laozi

A verified English rendering from the curated archive.

Quotes / Laozi / Q0162

English

Humans model themselves on earth; earth on heaven; heaven on the Way; and the Way on what is naturally so.
Thinker Laozi
School Daoism
Source Daodejing, Ch. 25
Theme Nature
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Daodejing, Ch. 25, within the tradition of Daoism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of nature, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Laozi's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
